download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL and return its contents as bytes
download_with_sha256_checksum: download a file from a URL and validate it against an expected sha256 checksum
download_with_retry_and_fallback: download a file from multiple fallback URLs with automatic retry on failure
download_with_rate_limit_handling: download a file with automatic backoff when receiving 429 Too Many Requests errors
download_with_interprocess_lock: download a file with inter-process locking to prevent redundant simultaneous downloads
